title: Battle Harnesses corpus pack field semantics
purpose: Machine-readable field and label semantics for an agent reader. Condensed from the research schema; not a second source of product facts.
reading_rules: This pack contains documented claims with provenance, not test results.
evidence_class names the kind of source. It does not mean the claim is true.
reviewer_status=unreviewed means no reviewer has accepted the claim. An unreviewed official-claim is a vendor or project assertion, not verified ground truth.
Do not treat official-claim, official-docs, or repository-or-code as independently confirmed fact unless reviewer_status is accepted and the evidence class actually supports that fact.
confidence is the recorded confidence in that source reading (high|medium|low|unknown). It is not a product quality score.
The literal string unknown means not established. It is not evidence that a product lacks a capability.
JSON null is invalid in the research ledgers. Do not invent null, n/a, or tbd in place of unknown.
social-discovery-only may identify a candidate lead. It cannot establish a product fact, relationship, or surface.
hands-on-observation and controlled-experiment are the only evidence classes that record a run. Their absence means this pack is not a test-result archive.
candidates.csv is excluded. This pack covers verified dossiers only. Counts of unverified candidates are outside the pack.

judged/judged.md is a distilled scenario-verdict layer over this same corpus: read its own binding-evidence-posture line before using any verdict in it. judged/README.md explains provenance. Both are optional — a pack without them still stands on the product/claim/relationship files.

contradictions.json is a mechanical index of claim rows whose notes carry dispute/update marker phrases (Disputed by, Contradicts canonical, Conflicts with, Updated by). It adds no new facts and is non-exhaustive; both sides of every dispute stay in the product files. Keep both sides; never average.

claim.notes: Every material product fact is a claim. Vendor claims, docs, code, observations, tests, independent sources, inference, and opinion stay on separate lines with their own evidence_class. Provenance fields are preserved verbatim from the ledger.

fields.claim_id: Stable claim identity. Format claim-[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. A new dated observation gets a new id.
fields.project_id: Product slug. Must resolve to a candidate in the corpus. Pack product files include only verified-dossier project ids.
fields.field: The claim dimension. One of the claim-field enumeration.
fields.value: JSON string, number, boolean, array, or object; never null. Field-specific enums apply.
fields.evidence_class: Source class. See enumerations.evidence_class. Not a truth bit.
fields.source_url: Absolute http(s) URL of the checked source.
fields.captured_at: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD on which this source was checked. Not an undated current label.
fields.product_version_or_date: Required text; may be unknown when the source does not identify a version.
fields.confidence: high|medium|low|unknown. Source-reading confidence, not a score.

product.notes: Structured fields already derived by generate-site-data.mjs. compare cells, surfaces_summary, catalogGroup, and notFor (when present) are derived views over claims and surfaces, not new facts.

fields.name: Display name from the candidate ledger or dossier title.
fields.compare: Compare-matrix cells mapped from claims and surfaces. kind text|state; state marks are s|u|n|k (supported, unsupported, not-applicable, unknown).
fields.surfaces_summary: Count and names of this product's surface rows.
fields.catalogGroup: Editorial catalogue placement when present; null otherwise. Not a quality verdict.
fields.notFor: Present only when site-data already derived not-for values from the dossier or not_for claims.

relationship.notes: Directed tuple (source_id, edge, target_id). Every edge points at an existing evidence_claim_id. social-discovery-only cannot support an edge.

fields.evidence_claim_id: Claim that supports the edge. Must belong to source_id.
fields.captured_at: Observation date YYYY-MM-DD; not later than the evidence claim capture.

surface.notes: One named access surface. Capability states are supported|unsupported|unknown, not booleans. Unsupported means the checked surface does not provide it; unknown means not established.

neighborhood.notes: Comparison aid grouped from comparison-neighborhoods.jsonl. Not a universal cluster or verdict. Shared labels such as cli or agent do not establish membership.

official-claim.supports: Primary-source evidence for identity and capability claims, when accepted.
official-claim.does_not_support: Treating the text as independently verified ground truth, especially when reviewer_status is unreviewed.

official-docs.supports: Primary-source evidence for identity and capability claims, when accepted.
official-docs.does_not_support: Equating documentation with a hands-on test result.

repository-or-code.meaning: First-party or canonical repository or code evidence.
repository-or-code.supports: Primary-source evidence for identity and capability claims, when accepted. Required class (with official-claim or official-docs) for fork_of and wraps_cli edges.
repository-or-code.does_not_support: A runtime observation of product behaviour.

hands-on-observation.meaning: A recorded direct run without a controlled design.
hands-on-observation.supports: A dated observation that someone ran the product.
hands-on-observation.does_not_support: A controlled experiment or a general quality verdict.

controlled-experiment.meaning: A run with declared controls and validation.
controlled-experiment.does_not_support: Backfilling test results onto official-claim rows.

independent-source.meaning: An independent technical source or test.

social-discovery-only.meaning: A lead from social discussion; not product proof.

inference.meaning: A reasoned interpretation of recorded evidence.
inference.supports: An explicit interpretation line that must not replace its source-backed lines.

editorial-opinion.supports: An explicit editorial line, kept separate from source-backed lines.

confidence.high: Recorded high confidence in this source reading.
confidence.medium: Recorded medium confidence in this source reading.
confidence.low: Recorded low confidence in this source reading.

reviewer_status.unreviewed: No reviewer has accepted this claim. Do not treat as verified.
reviewer_status.rejected: A reviewer rejected this claim. Site compare mapping ignores rejected rows; the pack still ships the row with this status.

relationship_edge.built_on: Substantive foundation in another runtime or toolkit.
relationship_edge.wraps_cli: Starts or controls another product's CLI process.
relationship_edge.orchestrates: Coordinates runs or agents supplied by another product.
relationship_edge.extends: Adds skills, hooks, plugins, memory, or workflow behavior.
relationship_edge.runs_in: Uses an execution environment or sandbox.
relationship_edge.connects_via: Uses MCP, SDK, RPC, API, WebSocket, or another protocol.
relationship_edge.reuses_auth_from: Uses another product's authenticated subscription or credentials.
relationship_edge.competes_with: Editorial edge for a substantially similar user job; not an architecture claim.
